en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ‘Āsim ibn Ḥumayd Al-Ḥannāť, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said:

Those from among our Shia who do not go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) are lacking in faith and their belief is incomplete. And even if they enter Paradise, their position will be lower than that of the believers.
